finding: RR's gaps are within noise but are presented as findings. The dashboard Squad tab headline is 'RR's measured weakness is batting under pressure: middle' and its so-what says 'the first thing to fix', with no interval drawn although gap_lo80/gap_hi80 exist. step5_gaps.csv: Middle -7.3 (80% -21.9 to +7.2), Death -3.2 (-17.0 to +10.7); only powerplay batting is outside noise (and it is above league). 'RR bowling is above league in every phase' is also within noise (all intervals include 0).
evidence: B p1 line 3, p6; F 0:32-0:45; dashboard Squad tab lead, chart and so-what; step5_gaps.csv verdict column; D A10 says 'within noise'
suggested_fix: Add 'within noise, directional only' to p1, p6, cheat sheet and video; add the 80% gap interval bars to the dashboard gap chart; soften 'weakness' / 'first thing to fix'.

finding: Plan A 'lifts both batting gaps' is circular and driven by tiny samples. The picks were chosen on the same High-pressure record, so adding them improves it by construction, and the backtest found no persistence. The Death gain (3.9 to 22.4) rests on 142 added balls at +69.4 per 100 and the picks' powerplay batting is -106.1 per 100 on 18 balls (planA_picks_only in the payload). The deck says 'direction, not proof' but the p6 headline reads as a result; the dashboard 'What RR still lacks' calls the picks 'pressure-proven options'.
evidence: B p6 headline; dashboard Squad 'What RR still lacks' and step5_plans; payload squad.planA_picks_only
suggested_fix: Reword the headline to 'Plan A would have added to ... on past data (selected on that same data)'; remove 'pressure-proven'; show picks-only per-100 values with ball counts and a caveat.
